works.idea_en: Change the geometry of a scientific instrument and the data it produces becomes a picture.
works.idea_zh: 改变科学仪器的几何形状，它产出的数据就变成了图像。
works.method: Custom radial gel electrophoresis polarised from inside to outside, with human DNA fragments cut to chosen sizes and imaged under blue-light transillumination and a camera.
works.method_zh: 定制的放射状凝胶电泳装置从内向外加电场，使用切割成特定长度的人类 DNA 片段，在蓝光透射下由摄像机成像。

works.title: Suspect Inversion Center
works.description: An open working lab in which the artist and collaborators use his own DNA to reproduce, band for band, the DNA 'fingerprint' image of O.J. Simpson shown at the 1995 murder trial.
works.description_zh: 一个开放运作的实验室：艺术家与合作者用他自己的 DNA，逐条带地复制 1995 年 O.J. Simpson 谋杀案庭审中出示的 DNA“指纹”图像。
works.idea_en: If anyone's DNA can be made to match an image, the 'DNA fingerprint' is a picture, not an identity.
works.idea_zh: 如果任何人的 DNA 都能被做成同一张图，那么“DNA 指纹”就是一张图片，而不是身份。
works.method: DNA extraction, PCR amplification, restriction digestion and gel electrophoresis performed live in the gallery, with fragment sizes chosen to reverse-engineer the historical image.
works.method_zh: 在展厅现场进行 DNA 提取、PCR 扩增、限制性酶切和凝胶电泳，通过选择片段大小来逆向复原那张历史图像。

works.title: The America Project
works.description: Visitors spit saline into a fountain-like spittoon; their pooled DNA is extracted and run through electrophoresis gels to form projected icons of power such as a crown, warplanes and a flag.
works.description_zh: 观众把漱口的盐水吐进一个像喷泉的痰盂；所有人的 DNA 混合后被提取，在电泳凝胶中形成王冠、战机和国旗等权力图像并投影出来。
works.idea_en: Pool everyone's DNA so the data can only speak about a collective, never an individual.
works.idea_zh: 把所有人的 DNA 混在一起，让数据只能讲述群体，而无法指认个人。
works.method: Cheek-cell DNA from hundreds of donors was extracted as one composite sample and cut and sized so that gel electrophoresis bands draw recognisable images, filmed live; made with scientist Solon Morse.
works.method_zh: 把数百位捐献者的口腔细胞 DNA 作为一个混合样本提取，经切割与定长后让电泳条带画出可辨认的图像，并实时拍摄；与科学家 Solon Morse 合作。

works.title: Utter
works.description: A glass apparatus incubates bacteria from the human mouth and releases moist, scented 'breath' through vents, simulating human exhalation without humans.
works.description_zh: 一套玻璃装置培养人类口腔中的细菌，并通过通风口释放潮湿、带气味的“呼吸”，在没有人的情况下模拟人的呼气。
works.idea_en: Separate breath from the body to show that every utterance is also a microbial exchange.
works.idea_zh: 把呼吸从身体中分离出来，说明每一次说话也是一次微生物交换。
works.method: Oral bacterial species are cultured in custom scientific glassware; air passes through liquid valve traps and 0.1-micron filters so odours escape but microbes do not; in progress since the COVID pandemic, glassware with Tracy Drier.
works.method_zh: 口腔细菌在定制的科学玻璃器皿中培养；空气经过液封阀和 0.1 微米过滤器，让气味散出而微生物不外泄；新冠疫情期间开始创作，玻璃器皿与 Tracy Drier 合作。

works.title: RuBisCo Stars
works.description: A message based on the genetic sequence of RuBisCO, the most abundant protein on Earth, was beamed from the Arecibo radio telescope toward nearby stars on the 35th anniversary of the 1974 Arecibo message.
works.description_zh: 以地球上最丰富的蛋白质 RuBisCO 的基因序列为内容的信息，在 1974 年 Arecibo 信息发送 35 周年之际，从 Arecibo 射电望远镜发往附近恒星。
works.idea_en: Send life's own code, not human symbols, as the greeting to other worlds.
works.idea_zh: 用生命自身的编码，而不是人类符号，作为对其他世界的问候。
works.method: The DNA and amino-acid sequence of a RuBisCO subunit was encoded into a radio signal and transmitted by the Arecibo Observatory radar in November 2009.
works.method_zh: 把 RuBisCO 一个亚基的 DNA 与氨基酸序列编码为无线电信号，于 2009 年 11 月由 Arecibo 天文台雷达发射。

works.title: Malus ecclesia
works.description: An ongoing plan, with George Church's lab at Harvard, to encode the English Wikipedia into the DNA of an ancient apple strain and create a literal tree of knowledge.
works.description_zh: 与哈佛 George Church 实验室合作的一项长期计划：把英文维基百科编码进一个古老苹果品种的 DNA，造出一棵真正的“知识之树”。
works.idea_en: Store the sum of human knowledge in the organism that myth calls the forbidden fruit.
works.idea_zh: 把人类知识的总和存进神话中被称为禁果的那种生物里。
works.method: Wikipedia text would be converted into DNA sequences and inserted into the genome of a roughly 4,000-year-old Malus strain using synthetic biology; the full encoding is proposed and was likely only partly realised.
works.method_zh: 将维基百科文本转换为 DNA 序列，并用合成生物学方法插入一个约 4000 年历史的苹果（Malus）品种的基因组；完整编码仍是提案，可能只部分实现。

works.title: Baitul Ma'mur: House of Angels
works.description: Synthetic DNA molecules each hold 19.5 nested encodings of the Arabic invocation 'Subhan Allah', so that a thin layer of DNA on a pin head carries more than two hundred million billion 'angels'.
works.description_zh: 每个合成 DNA 分子都嵌套存储 19.5 遍阿拉伯语祈祷语“Subhan Allah”，使针头上的一薄层 DNA 承载两亿亿个以上的“天使”。
works.idea_en: Use DNA's storage density to make an old question about angels on a pin literally countable.
works.idea_zh: 利用 DNA 的存储密度，让“针尖上有多少天使”这个古老问题可以真正计数。
works.method: A recursive coding scheme, inspired by Islamic geometric calligraphy, reads each base triplet as several numbers at once; the sequence was chemically synthesised in bulk; made with artist Sarah Khan.
works.method_zh: 受伊斯兰几何书法启发的递归编码方案，把每个碱基三联体同时解读为多个数字；序列经大批量化学合成；与艺术家 Sarah Khan 合作。
keywords: Prix Ars Electronica Artificial Intelligence & Life Art 2021

works.title: Essay Concerning Human Understanding
works.description: A canary in Lexington, Kentucky, and a philodendron in New York held a live sonic dialogue over a phone line: the bird's song reached the plant, and the plant's electrical response triggered sounds sent back to the bird.
works.description_zh: 肯塔基州列克星敦的一只金丝雀和纽约的一株喜林芋通过电话线进行实时声音对话：鸟的歌声传给植物，植物的电反应触发声音再传回给鸟。
works.idea_en: Connect two species that never meet through a telematic loop and let them take turns.
works.idea_zh: 用远程通信回路把两个永不相见的物种连接起来，让它们轮流“说话”。
works.method: An electrode on the leaf fed microvoltage changes into brain-wave analysis software (IBVA) and a MAX patch that controlled a MIDI sequencer; made with Ikuo Nakamura.
works.method_zh: 叶片上的电极把微电压变化送入脑电分析软件 IBVA 和 MAX 程序，再控制 MIDI 音序器；与 Ikuo Nakamura 合作。

works.title: Teleporting an Unknown State
works.description: A single seed in a dark room grows only on the light that remote internet users send through live video feeds, projected onto the soil.
works.description_zh: 黑暗房间里的一粒种子，只依靠远程网民通过实时视频传来、投射在土壤上的光生长。
works.idea_en: Make the network a life-support system, so a plant grows only if strangers keep sending light.
works.idea_zh: 让网络成为生命维持系统：只有陌生人不断送来光，植物才能长大。
works.method: Participants pointed cameras at the sky and streamed the images over the internet (CU-SeeMe videoconferencing); a projector above the pedestal turned the incoming video into light for photosynthesis.
works.method_zh: 参与者把摄像头对准天空，通过互联网（CU-SeeMe 视频会议）传送画面；基座上方的投影仪把传来的视频变成供植物光合作用的光。

works.title: A-positive
works.description: A human and a robot are joined by intravenous lines: the person donates blood to the 'biobot', which extracts oxygen from it to keep a small flame alive, and in return feeds dextrose into the person's vein.
works.description_zh: 一个人和一台机器人通过静脉输液管相连：人把血输给“生物机器人”，机器人从血中提取氧气维持一小簇火焰，并反过来把葡萄糖输入人的静脉。
works.idea_en: A robot that depends on human blood turns the human-machine relation into mutual feeding.
works.idea_zh: 一台依赖人血的机器人，把人机关系变成相互喂养。
works.method: A 'phlebot' circulated donated red blood cells to extract oxygen for a small flame and delivered dextrose intravenously; made with Ed Bennett.
works.method_zh: 一台“采血机器人”（phlebot）循环捐献的红细胞，从中提取氧气燃起小火焰，并通过静脉输送葡萄糖；与 Ed Bennett 合作。

works.title: Move 36
works.description: A plant stands on a chessboard of earth and sand at the square where Deep Blue made move 36 against Kasparov; its genome carries a 'Cartesian gene' that spells 'Cogito ergo sum' in DNA.
works.description_zh: 一株植物站在由泥土和沙子组成的棋盘上，正好位于深蓝对卡斯帕罗夫走出第 36 步的那一格；它的基因组携带一个用 DNA 写出“我思故我在”的“笛卡尔基因”。
works.idea_en: Write a statement about the mind into a mindless organism and place it where a machine out-thought a human.
works.idea_zh: 把一句关于心智的话写进没有心智的生物，并放在机器胜过人类的那一格上。
works.method: Descartes' sentence was converted to 8-bit ASCII and mapped to bases (A=00, C=01, G=10, T=11), giving a 52-base gene that was coupled with a gene that makes the leaves curl so its expression is visible.
works.method_zh: 把笛卡尔的句子转为 8 位 ASCII，再映射为碱基（A=00，C=01，G=10，T=11），得到一个 52 个碱基的基因，并与一个使叶片卷曲的基因相连，让它的表达肉眼可见。

works.title: Cypher
works.description: A stainless-steel book that opens into a DIY transgenic kit: following the protocol, the reader inserts synthetic DNA encoding a poem into bacteria and grows the 'poem' as living colonies.
works.description_zh: 一本不锈钢书，打开后是一套 DIY 转基因工具包：读者按照说明把编码了一首诗的合成 DNA 导入细菌，让这首“诗”长成活的菌落。
works.idea_en: Reading becomes an act of making life: the reader decides whether the poem comes alive.
works.idea_zh: 阅读变成创造生命的行为：由读者决定这首诗是否“活”起来。
works.method: The kit holds Petri dishes, agar, nutrients, loops, pipettes, a transformation protocol and synthetic DNA written with a letter-to-base code Kac devised, likely transformed into E. coli.
works.method_zh: 工具包中有培养皿、琼脂、营养物、接种环、移液管、转化说明，以及用 Kac 自创的字母-碱基编码写成的合成 DNA，可能用于转化大肠杆菌。

works.title: Culturing <Paper>cut
works.description: The artist cuts his own cyanobacteria research paper into paper-cut patterns, removing subjective sentences, then inoculates cyanobacteria where those sentences were; the bacteria glide over the cut-outs and draw new patterns.
works.description_zh: 艺术家把自己关于蓝细菌的研究论文剪成剪纸图案，剪掉带有主观色彩的句子，再在这些位置接种蓝细菌；细菌在剪纸上滑行，画出新的图案。
works.idea_en: Let the organism studied in a paper edit and overwrite that paper.
works.idea_zh: 让论文研究的生物去编辑、改写这篇论文。
works.method: Filamentous motile cyanobacteria from local ponds are cultured on paper cut-outs laid on solid media, where cut edges and conditions steer their collective gliding into species-specific patterns.
works.method_zh: 把采自附近池塘、会滑行的丝状蓝细菌培养在铺于固体培养基上的剪纸上，剪纸边缘和培养条件引导它们的集体运动，形成随物种而异的图案。

works.title: Biogenic Timestamp
works.description: Cyanobacteria grow over discarded PC motherboards, absorbing and rearranging dissolved metals and minerals and slowly building sediment over the electronics.
works.description_zh: 蓝细菌在废弃的电脑主板上生长，吸收并重组溶出的金属与矿物，慢慢在电子元件上堆积出沉积层。
works.idea_en: Let microbes write geological time onto our electronic waste.
works.idea_zh: 让微生物把地质时间写在我们的电子垃圾上。
works.method: Oscillatoria, Nostoc, Pseudanabaena and Synechococcus elongatus PCC 7942 (one strain engineered to raise alkaline phosphatase and promote lithification) are cultured with motherboards and minerals in culture media.
works.method_zh: Oscillatoria、Nostoc、Pseudanabaena 与 Synechococcus elongatus PCC 7942（其中一株经基因改造以提高碱性磷酸酶、促进成岩）与主板和矿物一起在培养基中培养。

works.title: Photoautotropica
works.description: Cyanobacteria in culture vessels photosynthesise not with sunlight but with light from projected films of cyanobacterial colonies forming patterns under the microscope.
works.description_zh: 培养容器中的蓝细菌不靠阳光，而是靠投影出来的光进行光合作用，投影内容是显微镜下蓝细菌菌落形成图案的影像。
works.idea_en: Feed organisms on images of their own kind, closing a loop between life and its representation.
works.idea_zh: 用同类的影像“喂养”生物，在生命与其图像之间形成闭环。
works.method: Geitlerinema, Nostoc and Leptolyngbya collected in Tokyo grow in liquid and gel media lit only by LED and video projection controlled by a PC.
works.method_zh: 采自东京的 Geitlerinema、Nostoc 和 Leptolyngbya 在液体和凝胶培养基中生长，唯一光源是电脑控制的 LED 和影像投影。

works.title: The Communicating Bacteria Dress
works.description: A whitework-embroidered dress stained with pigmented bacteria that change colour when they send and receive chemical signals, overlaid with 3D-mapped video projections.
works.description_zh: 一件白绣连衣裙，用会在收发化学信号时变色的色素细菌染色，并叠加 3D 映射影像投影。
works.idea_en: Make bacterial conversation visible as colour on a garment.
works.idea_zh: 把细菌之间的“对话”变成衣服上可见的颜色。
works.method: Quorum-sensing pigmented bacteria (likely Chromobacterium violaceum, which makes violacein when signalling) were grown on the textile and then sterilised; video mapping made with Alex May.
works.method_zh: 在织物上培养具群体感应能力的色素细菌（可能是在信号交流时产生紫色素的 Chromobacterium violaceum），之后灭菌处理；影像映射与 Alex May 合作。

works.title: The Sequence Project
works.description: A series including a dress stained with Staphylococcus aureus from the artist's body and a VR piece, both driven by the 2.8 million base pairs of that strain's genome, which the artist sequenced herself.
works.description_zh: 一系列作品，包括用艺术家身上的金黄色葡萄球菌染色的连衣裙和一件 VR 作品，均以她亲自测序的该菌株 280 万个碱基对的基因组数据为素材。
works.idea_en: Your own microbes' genome becomes personal data you can wear and walk inside.
works.idea_zh: 自己身上微生物的基因组，成为可以穿在身上、可以走进去的个人数据。
works.method: Whole-genome sequencing of a strain from the artist's body with the Modernising Medical Microbiology project; the raw and assembled sequence data were video-mapped onto the dress and rendered in VR with Alex May.
works.method_zh: 与 Modernising Medical Microbiology 项目合作，对来自艺术家身体的菌株进行全基因组测序；原始与组装后的序列数据通过影像映射投在裙子上，并与 Alex May 合作做成 VR。

works.title: The Outline of Paradise (Sustainable Luminosity)
works.description: A speculative product and video proposing that city advertising could be written by swarms of genetically modified midges that glow like fireflies and fly in trained formations.
works.description_zh: 一个思辨性产品和影像：设想城市广告可以由像萤火虫一样发光、按训练好的队形飞行的转基因摇蚊群来“书写”。
works.idea_en: Replace screens with trained, glowing living swarms and ask what that would mean.
works.idea_zh: 用训练过的发光活体虫群取代屏幕，并追问这意味着什么。
works.method: Developed as a product for the super-cell synthetic-biology supermarket with the iGEM 2010 Weimar-Heidelberg arts team; glowing Chironomus midges were proposed and training setups tested, while the luminous swarm itself is simulated in video.
works.method_zh: 作为合成生物学“超市”super-cell 的产品，与 iGEM 2010 Weimar-Heidelberg 艺术团队共同开发；提出发光摇蚊的方案并测试训练装置，发光虫群本身以影像模拟。

works.title: The Outline of Paradise (installation)
works.description: Non-biting midges are bred in an aquarium in the gallery; their swarms are exposed to sound and video to find out whether swarm flight can be influenced and the behaviour passed to later generations.
works.description_zh: 在展厅的水族箱里饲养不叮人的摇蚊；让它们的虫群接受声音和影像刺激，观察群飞是否能被影响，并传给后代。
works.idea_en: Treat a swarm as a living display that might be trained, and test it in public.
works.idea_zh: 把虫群当作可能被训练的活体显示器，并在公众面前测试。
works.method: Chironomus riparius larvae are reared in sand and water under artificial daylight; swarm tracks were observed under live cello improvisation and projected airshow loops, with scientific advice from ecotoxicologists.
works.method_zh: Chironomus riparius 幼虫在沙和水中、人造日光下饲养；在现场大提琴即兴演奏和循环播放的特技飞行影像下观察群飞轨迹，并有生态毒理学家提供科学咨询。

works.title: Insect Songs
works.description: Musicians improvise with swarming chironomid midges: the midges' wingbeat tones are amplified, and cello playing visibly stirs lazy midges into intense swarming.
works.description_zh: 音乐家与群飞的摇蚊一起即兴：摇蚊振翅的音调被放大，大提琴的演奏会明显让懒散的摇蚊开始激烈群飞。
works.idea_en: Technology should only adjust our senses so two species can respond to each other in real time.
works.idea_zh: 技术只用来调节我们的感官，让两个物种能实时回应彼此。
works.method: Midges in a sound-isolated box are recorded with sensitive microphones and their pitch analysed in real time, while players with cello and electronics respond; with Christina Meissner and Teresa Carrasco.
works.method_zh: 隔音箱中的摇蚊由灵敏麦克风录音并实时分析音高，演奏者用大提琴和电子设备回应；与 Christina Meissner 和 Teresa Carrasco 合作。

works.title: Drosophila Karaoke Bar
works.description: Visitors sing or play into a karaoke booth with fruit flies in a sound-isolated box; the flies' courtship songs and the humans' tones are picked up and shown together so people can try to sing with the flies.
works.description_zh: 观众在一个卡拉 OK 亭里对着隔音箱中的果蝇唱歌或演奏；果蝇的求偶歌声与人的声音被同时拾取和显示，让人尝试与果蝇一起唱。
works.idea_en: Invite people into a lab model organism's own culture: its songs.
works.idea_zh: 邀请人进入实验室模式生物自己的文化：它们的歌。
works.method: Drosophila wing vibrations are captured with sensitive microphones; Max/MSP identifies pitch of fly and human sounds and visualises natural harmonics in real time (Fly Songs module programmed by Johann Nigel).
works.method_zh: 用灵敏麦克风捕捉果蝇翅膀振动；Max/MSP 识别果蝇与人声的音高，并实时显示自然泛音（其中 Fly Songs 模块由 Johann Nigel 编程）。

works.title: Time of the Flies
works.description: A development of Drosophila Karaoke Bar in which live fruit-fly cultures are observed on video screens that show their group behaviour and spacing, reflecting on distance and proximity during the pandemic.
works.description_zh: 《Drosophila Karaoke Bar》的延续：活的果蝇培养群通过视频屏幕呈现，展示它们的群体行为和彼此间距，借此反思疫情期间的距离与亲近。
works.idea_en: Living with an organism's rhythms changes your own; share that with the audience.
works.idea_zh: 与一种生物的节律共同生活会改变你自己的节律；把这种体验分享给观众。
works.method: Fruit-fly cultures kept in the artist's home and exhibition lab are filmed and tracked, and an interface visualises their collective movement and sounds; first shown in SWARM at Science Gallery Melbourne.
works.method_zh: 在艺术家家中和展览实验室饲养的果蝇被拍摄和追踪，一个界面把它们的集体运动和声音可视化；首次在墨尔本 Science Gallery 的 SWARM 展中展出。

works.title: Imbued with Light
works.description: Glass cylinders of mud and compost act as microbial fuel cells whose bacteria break down organic waste and generate the current that lights an LED orb in the installation.
works.description_zh: 装满泥浆和堆肥的玻璃圆柱就是微生物燃料电池，其中的细菌分解有机废物并产生电流，点亮装置中的 LED 球体。
works.idea_en: Let soil bacteria visibly power the artwork that describes them.
works.idea_zh: 让土壤细菌亲自为描述它们的作品供电。
works.method: Sealed microbial fuel cells with graphite electrodes host anaerobic bacteria such as Geobacter that release electrons while digesting carbohydrates; MFA thesis at San Francisco Art Institute.
works.method_zh: 密封的微生物燃料电池内有石墨电极，其中的厌氧细菌（如 Geobacter）在分解碳水化合物时释放电子；旧金山艺术学院 MFA 毕业作品。

works.title: Microbial Schöppingen
works.description: A Plexiglas model of the German village of Schöppingen in which bacterial communities live in the houses and together generate the electricity that lights the town hall, accompanied by live shadow-puppet shows.
works.description_zh: 一个德国小镇 Schöppingen 的有机玻璃模型：细菌群落住在各座房子里，共同发电点亮市政厅，并配有现场皮影表演。
works.idea_en: Show a microbial society as a town whose collective work keeps the lights on.
works.idea_zh: 把微生物社会呈现为一座小镇，靠集体劳动让灯亮着。
works.method: Each house pair is a microbial fuel cell: an anaerobic anode house with bacteria feeding on food scraps connected through a proton-exchange membrane to an oxygenated cathode house, wired in series to a white LED; tuned with LabMET, Ghent University.
works.method_zh: 每对房子就是一个微生物燃料电池：以食物残渣为食的细菌所在的厌氧阳极房，经质子交换膜连接到有氧的阴极房，串联起来驱动一盏白色 LED；与根特大学 LabMET 合作优化。

works.title: Perhaps, art begins with the fireflies
works.description: In a dark room, many small green glows move in the dark: the light of fireflies from about 100 million years ago, recreated with a luciferase enzyme resurrected from their ancestral gene sequence.
works.description_zh: 在黑暗的房间里，许多绿色小光点在移动：这是约一亿年前萤火虫的光，用由祖先基因序列复原的荧光素酶重新制造出来。
works.idea_en: Molecular reconstruction can let us see what an extinct animal's world looked like.
works.idea_zh: 分子复原可以让我们看到已灭绝动物眼中的世界。
works.method: Luciferase genes from living fireflies were used to infer the ancestral sequence computationally; the resurrected enzyme was produced and mixed with luciferin and oxygen to emit green light; an anteroom shows models, CT scans, specimens and prints.
works.method_zh: 用现生萤火虫的荧光素酶基因通过计算推断祖先序列；表达出复原的酶后与荧光素和氧气混合发出绿光；前厅展示分子模型、CT 扫描、标本和版画。
keywords: Prix Ars Electronica Artificial Intelligence & Life Art 2023

paper.title: Resurrecting the ancient glow of the fireflies

works.title: Deep Learning Insole
works.description: Disposable silicone insoles hold microbial cultures that respond to sweat during running and report chemical markers of fatigue and well-being to the runner.
works.description_zh: 一次性硅胶鞋垫里装有微生物培养物，跑步时对汗液作出反应，并向跑者报告与疲劳和健康相关的化学指标。
works.idea_en: Use living microbes as wearable biochemical sensors that sit where the body sweats.
works.idea_zh: 把活的微生物当作贴近出汗部位的可穿戴生化传感器。
works.method: Microbial cultures in insole cavities react to skin and sweat chemistry, and their changes are digitised into benchmarks; a PUMA and MIT Design Lab project powered by Biorealize, shown at Milan Design Week.
works.method_zh: 鞋垫腔体中的微生物对皮肤和汗液的化学成分产生反应，其变化被数字化为指标；PUMA 与 MIT Design Lab 的合作项目，由 Biorealize 提供技术，在米兰设计周展出。

works.title: Yenikapı (Night Sways, but Underground Listens)
works.description: A sculpture filled with Istanbul soil logs the electrical activity of its bacteria for two weeks and turns it into a procedural animation of subterranean microbial rhythms.
works.description_zh: 一件装有伊斯坦布尔土壤的雕塑，连续两周记录其中细菌的电活动，并把它转化为地下微生物节律的程序动画。
works.idea_en: Read the city's ground as a living archive by listening to its microbes' electricity.
works.idea_zh: 通过聆听微生物的电信号，把城市地下读作一部活的档案。
works.method: Soil bacteria in the sculpture generate small currents (a soil microbial fuel cell, likely), read by custom electronics that drive screen-printed electroluminescent panels and the animation; shown in REBUILD at Contemporary Istanbul.
works.method_zh: 雕塑中的土壤细菌产生微弱电流（很可能是土壤微生物燃料电池），由定制电路读取，驱动丝网印刷的电致发光面板和动画；在 Contemporary Istanbul 的 REBUILD 展中展出。

works.title: BBa_K221000: First Volume of Teenage Gene Poems
works.description: E. coli transformed with a BioBrick that makes geosmin produce the smell of wet earth after rain, grown in a collapsible DIY bio lab inside a geodesic dome.
works.description_zh: 在一个可折叠、搭在网格穹顶里的 DIY 生物实验室中，被导入合成土臭素（geosmin）BioBrick 的大肠杆菌散发出雨后湿土的气味。
works.idea_en: Encode the smell of the Indian monsoon as a genetic part, then ask what that promise means.
works.idea_zh: 把印度季风的气味编码成一个基因元件，再追问这种承诺意味着什么。
works.method: The standard part BBa_K221000 (geosmin synthase) was transformed into E. coli and incubated in a custom incubator built from hacked consumer electronics; lab plans shared via hackteria.org.
works.method_zh: 把标准元件 BBa_K221000（土臭素合酶）转入大肠杆菌，在用改装消费电子产品自制的培养箱中培养；实验室图纸通过 hackteria.org 公开。

works.title: Searching for the Ubiquitous Genetically Engineered Machine
works.description: Standard BioBrick primers are used as random PCR probes on soil samples in a self-built public lab, producing gel 'signatures' of soil biodiversity as a baseline for a future full of engineered parts.
works.description_zh: 在自建的公共实验室里，把标准 BioBrick 引物当作随机 PCR 探针用于土壤样本，得到土壤生物多样性的凝胶“签名”，作为未来工程元件遍布环境时的基线。
works.idea_en: Turn synthetic biology's standard parts into a citizen tool for reading the environment.
works.idea_zh: 把合成生物学的标准元件变成公民读取环境的工具。
works.method: Random-primed PCR with BioBrick prefix and suffix primers on DNA from soil samples, visualised as bands in gel electrophoresis; blueprints for the public lab published online.
works.method_zh: 用 BioBrick 前缀和后缀引物对土壤 DNA 进行随机引物 PCR，以凝胶电泳条带呈现；公共实验室的图纸在线公开。

works.title: Spirit Molecule I
works.description: A greenhouse of legal psychoactive plants and a four-channel video imagine a future ritual of mourning in which a dead person's DNA is engineered into a plant that the bereaved then consume.
works.description_zh: 一座栽满合法致幻植物的温室和一部四频道影像，想象一种未来的哀悼仪式：把逝者的 DNA 植入植物，再由亲人服下。
works.idea_en: Biotechnology could become a material for grief, not only for health or profit.
works.idea_zh: 生物技术也可以成为寄托哀思的材料，而不只关乎健康或利润。
works.method: Speculative narrative video and a living greenhouse installation; the engineering of human DNA into the plants is proposed, not performed; with Phillip Andrew Lewis.
works.method_zh: 思辨叙事影像加活体温室装置；把人类 DNA 植入植物只是提出的设想，并未真正实施；与 Phillip Andrew Lewis 合作。

works.title: PANCREAS
works.description: A processual sculpture shreds copies of Hegel's Phenomenology of Spirit, lets bacteria digest the paper into glucose, and feeds that sugar to human brain cells growing in a glass tank.
works.description_zh: 一件过程雕塑：把黑格尔《精神现象学》的书页粉碎，让细菌把纸消化成葡萄糖，再用这些糖喂养玻璃缸里生长的人类脑细胞。
works.idea_en: Translate information into food: a book literally becomes the metabolism of a brain in a vat.
works.idea_zh: 把信息翻译成食物：一本书真的变成了缸中之脑的代谢。
works.method: Paper pulp is fermented by cellulose-degrading bacteria in an artificial intestine, the glucose is filtered and purified, then supplied to cultured human brain cells; realised with Thomas Seppi, Medical University of Innsbruck.
works.method_zh: 纸浆在“人工肠道”发酵罐中被分解纤维素的细菌发酵，得到的葡萄糖经过滤纯化后供给培养的人类脑细胞；与因斯布鲁克医科大学的 Thomas Seppi 合作实现。

works.title: RADIO VAN GOGH / (H)EAR
works.description: Cartilage cells taken from the artist's ear grow on the surface of CDs; a modified CD player reads the growing cells and software turns the data into sound, streamed live online for up to three weeks.
works.description_zh: 从艺术家耳朵取出的软骨细胞在 CD 表面生长；改装的 CD 播放器读取这些正在生长的细胞，软件把数据转成声音，在网上直播，最长持续三周。
works.idea_en: Use a consumer playback device as a sensor, so living tissue becomes the record that plays itself.
works.idea_zh: 把普通的播放设备当作传感器，让活组织本身成为会自己播放的唱片。
works.method: Human ear chondrocytes are cultured between two CDs in medium inside a 37 °C player; a CD-based cell-counting read-out is converted to audio in real time; made with Thomas Seppi, Medical University of Innsbruck.
works.method_zh: 人耳软骨细胞在两张 CD 之间的培养液中生长，播放器保持 37 °C；基于 CD 的细胞计数读取信号被实时转换成音频；与因斯布鲁克医科大学的 Thomas Seppi 合作。

works.title: FlaNeuron
works.description: A knitted, 3D-printed robotic 'walker' is coupled to a culture of neuronal cells on a multi-electrode array, presented at BioTehna in Ljubljana as a semi-living cybernetic creature that needs care protocols.
works.description_zh: 一个用编织和 3D 打印制成的“漫游者”机器人与多电极阵列上的神经细胞培养物相连，在卢布尔雅那 BioTehna 展出，是一个需要照护规程的半活体控制论生物。
works.idea_en: Treat a neuron-robot hybrid as a new kind of creature whose care has to be designed, not only its function.
works.idea_zh: 把神经元与机器人的混合体当作一种新生物：需要设计的不仅是功能，还有照护方式。
works.method: Neuronal cells grown by Kristijan Tkalec (BioTehna) on a Multi Channel Systems MEA are linked through custom electronics to a stereolithography-printed and knitted walking mechanism; the exact control loop is likely still experimental at this stage.
works.method_zh: 由 BioTehna 的 Kristijan Tkalec 培养的神经细胞生长在 Multi Channel Systems 多电极阵列上，经定制电子设备连接到光固化打印加编织的行走机构；此阶段的控制回路很可能仍处于实验状态。

works.title: Biobot: AI ARThropods
works.description: Neurons reprogrammed from the artist's own fat cells grow on an electrode array; their electrical signals drive a robot, and an AI compares them with arthropod leg movements to propose ever-new zoomorphic bodies.
works.description_zh: 由艺术家自身脂肪细胞重编程而来的神经元生长在电极阵列上；它们的电信号驱动机器人，AI 再把信号与节肢动物的腿部运动比对，不断提出新的类动物身体形态。
works.idea_en: Let a living 'brain on a chip' decide what body it should have, not only how that body moves.
works.idea_zh: 让一块活的“芯片上的大脑”决定自己应该拥有怎样的身体，而不只是决定身体怎样运动。
works.method: Adipose-derived cells are reprogrammed into neurons on a multi-electrode array; analogue spikes are digitised, amplified and fed to an AI that matches them to a library of arthropod gaits and suggests joint and limb counts, from which the artist builds the robot; earlier stages (Biobot 1.1, 1.2) looped robot motion back to the neurons.
works.method_zh: 脂肪来源细胞在多电极阵列上被重编程为神经元；模拟尖峰信号经数字化、放大后输入 AI，AI 将其与节肢动物步态库匹配并给出关节和肢体数量，艺术家据此制作机器人；早期版本（Biobot 1.1、1.2）还把机器人运动反馈给神经元。
keywords: Prix Ars Electronica Artificial Intelligence & Life Art 2023

works.title: Biobot: Code of Diversity
works.description: A robot with a body resembling no animal learns to cross a linear track in Kapelica Gallery; its gaits come from algorithms today, and a neural organoid on an electrode is meant to take over control in the next generation.
works.description_zh: 一个不像任何动物的机器人在 Kapelica 画廊的直线赛道上学习前进；目前它的步态由算法生成，下一代将交由电极上的神经类器官来控制。
works.idea_en: Design a body that confuses human-written algorithms, so a living brain has room to find its own way of moving.
works.idea_zh: 设计一个让人类编写的算法也困惑的身体，给活体大脑留出自己找到运动方式的空间。
works.method: A modified RoboGrammar generates atypical robot skeletons; the DIAYN (Diversity Is All You Need) algorithm, guided by computer vision of the robot's position, learns varied gaits from motor signals, while a neuronal organoid on an electrode translates signals between neurons and the joint controller.
works.method_zh: 改写的 RoboGrammar 生成非典型机器人骨架；DIAYN（Diversity Is All You Need）算法在计算机视觉追踪机器人位置的引导下，从电机信号中学习多样步态；电极上的神经类器官在神经元与关节控制器之间转换信号。

works.title: Plato's Prisoners
works.description: Visitors speak into a microphone; their voices become vibrations in the liquid around a living cerebral organoid, and the organoid's neural response shapes the light and sound filling the room.
works.description_zh: 观众对着麦克风说话，声音变成振动传入一个活体大脑类器官周围的液体，类器官的神经反应再塑造充满房间的灯光和声音。
works.idea_en: Make a two-way conversation between a person and a mini-brain, so its moral status is felt rather than debated.
works.idea_zh: 在人和“迷你大脑”之间建立双向对话，让人亲身感受而不只是讨论它的道德地位。
works.method: Human stem-cell-derived cerebral organoids (about 90 days old) are stimulated by voice-driven vibration and their recorded activity controls light and sound; the displayed organoid is swapped every three days from a sibling colony kept in an incubator; made with Marie Sejberg Øhlenschlæger, Pia Jensen and Martin Røssel Larsen (University of Southern Denmark).
works.method_zh: 由人类干细胞培养的大脑类器官（约 90 天大）受到声音驱动的振动刺激，记录到的活动控制灯光和声音；展出的类器官每三天从培养箱中的“兄弟”群体里轮换一次；与南丹麦大学的 Marie Sejberg Øhlenschlæger、Pia Jensen、Martin Røssel Larsen 合作。
keywords: Prix Ars Electronica Artificial Life & Intelligence 2025

works.title: Growth
works.description: An immersive sound installation built from hydrophone recordings of living ovarian cancer organoids, whose metabolic frequencies are slowed and amplified around a suspended sculpture.
works.description_zh: 一件沉浸式声音装置，素材来自对活体卵巢癌类器官的水听器录音；它们的代谢频率被放慢、放大，环绕着一件悬挂的雕塑。
works.idea_en: Listen to tissue growth itself, making the line between creation and uncontrolled growth audible.
works.idea_zh: 直接聆听组织的生长，让“孕育”与“失控生长”之间的界线变得可以听见。
works.method: Ultrasensitive hydrophones recorded organoids from the OvaCure Collection biobank; frequencies were isolated, time-stretched and amplified, then played with light in the space.
works.method_zh: 用超灵敏水听器录制 OvaCure Collection 生物样本库中的类器官，提取频率后进行时间拉伸和放大，再与灯光一起在空间中播放。

works.title: Bricolage
works.description: Human heart muscle cells, made from donors' blood via stem cells, beat on silk scaffolds inside a clay-and-glass incubator, twitching and self-assembling into living automatons large enough to see with the naked eye.
works.description_zh: 由捐献者血液经干细胞培养出的人类心肌细胞在丝质支架上跳动，放在陶土与玻璃制成的培养箱中，抽动并自组装成肉眼可见的活体自动机。
works.idea_en: Show cellular life at human scale without screens, so the uncanny 'aliveness' of fragments is felt directly.
works.idea_zh: 不借助屏幕，在人的尺度上展示细胞生命，让碎片化生命的“诡异活性”被直接感受。
works.method: White blood cells were reprogrammed into iPS cells and differentiated into cardiomyocytes (Sebastian Diecke), seeded on custom-printed silk scaffolds; with Nathan Thompson.
works.method_zh: 白细胞被重编程为诱导多能干细胞，再分化成心肌细胞（Sebastian Diecke），接种在定制打印的丝质支架上；与 Nathan Thompson 合作。
keywords: Prix Ars Electronica Artificial Intelligence & Life Art 2021

works.title: Snowflake
works.description: A neural network grown from Guy Ben-Ary's own cells, repeatedly stimulated with the image of a snowflake, is displayed frozen in a liquid-nitrogen container as a 'memory' kept for a cryonic future.
works.description_zh: 一个由 Guy Ben-Ary 自身细胞培养出的神经网络，被反复用雪花图像刺激后冷冻，放在液氮容器中展出，作为留给冷冻复活未来的一段“记忆”。
works.idea_en: Treat plasticity as a material: write an image into living neurons, then freeze the memory as an object.
works.idea_zh: 把神经可塑性当作材料：把一幅图像写进活神经元，再把这段记忆冷冻成一件物体。
works.method: Revisits a 2004-2006 experiment in Steve Potter's Georgia Tech lab where mouse neurons on 60-electrode MEAs were trained with a snowflake pattern and cryopreserved; the new version uses the artist's own neurons; with Boryana Rossa and Oleg Mavromatti.
works.method_zh: 重访 2004–2006 年在佐治亚理工 Steve Potter 实验室进行的实验：60 电极阵列上的小鼠神经元被雪花图案反复刺激后冷冻保存；新版本使用艺术家自己的神经元；与 Boryana Rossa、Oleg Mavromatti 合作。

works.title: The Living Screen
works.description: A 'Bio-Kino' in which micron-scale films are projected onto screens grown from living tissue; as the cells change and eventually die, they distort the images viewers watch through a coffin-like projector.
works.description_zh: 一台“生物电影机”：把微米尺度的影片投射到由活组织长成的屏幕上；细胞不断变化直至死亡，扭曲了观众透过棺材般投影器看到的画面。
works.idea_en: Use living tissue as the display surface, so the medium itself ages and alters the message.
works.idea_zh: 用活组织做显示表面，让媒介本身的衰老去改变所播放的内容。
works.method: Tissue cultures are prepared as screens under a microscope-based 'Bio-Projector' modelled on the Kinetoscope, which projects 25-50 µm 'Nano-Movies' onto them; with Tanya Visosevic and Bruce Murphy.
works.method_zh: 把组织培养物制备成屏幕，放在仿照 Kinetoscope 的显微“生物投影器”下，投射 25–50 微米的“纳米电影”；与 Tanya Visosevic、Bruce Murphy 合作。

works.title: The Body is a Big Place
works.description: An immersive installation around a working heart-perfusion system; in live performances a pair of fresh pig hearts is reanimated to beat again, re-enacting steps of human heart transplantation.
works.description_zh: 一件围绕可运转的心脏灌注系统展开的沉浸式装置；现场表演中，一对新鲜猪心被重新灌注至再次跳动，重演人类心脏移植的若干环节。
works.idea_en: Stage an organ as a performer to show that death is a stretch of time, not a single moment.
works.idea_zh: 让器官成为表演者，说明死亡是一段时间，而不是一个瞬间。
works.method: A Langendorff-style perfusion rig pumps oxygenated solution through the coronary vessels of pig hearts to restart beating, shown with five-channel video of transplant recipients and donors' families and a sound work by Gail Priest; with Peta Clancy.
works.method_zh: 类似 Langendorff 的灌注装置把含氧溶液泵入猪心冠状血管使其重新跳动，搭配器官移植受者与捐献者家属参与拍摄的五通道影像和 Gail Priest 的声音作品；与 Peta Clancy 合作。

works.title: Supraorganism
works.description: About twenty robotic blown-glass sculptures light up, move and sound according to predictions from a neural network trained on data recorded in a bee colony, and react to visitors' presence.
works.description_zh: 约二十件机器人化的吹制玻璃雕塑，依据一个用蜂群记录数据训练的神经网络的预测而发光、运动和发声，并对观众的到来作出反应。
works.idea_en: Let a machine inherit a colony's collective rhythm, so an installation behaves like a swarm.
works.idea_zh: 让机器继承蜂群的集体节律，使装置像一个群体那样行动。
works.method: Sensor data from a honeybee hive trains a custom machine-learning model whose live predictions drive lights and motors in the glass modules; ambient sensors add visitor response.
works.method_zh: 来自蜂巢的传感器数据训练定制的机器学习模型，模型的实时预测驱动玻璃模块中的灯光和电机；环境传感器让装置对观众作出反应。

works.title: Blood Wars
works.description: Participants' white blood cells are set against each other in a petri dish in a mock World Cup tournament; the 'winning' cells advance to the next round and blood trophies are awarded.
works.description_zh: 参与者的白细胞在培养皿中两两对决，形式模仿世界杯淘汰赛；“获胜”的细胞晋级下一轮，最后颁发装有血液的奖杯。
works.idea_en: Turn a lab assay into a game, so people argue about inheritance and 'blood traits' through their own cells.
works.idea_zh: 把实验室检测变成一场比赛，让人们借自己的细胞讨论遗传与“血统”。
works.method: Blood is drawn from pairs of participants, white blood cells are isolated, stained and co-cultured, and their interaction is filmed with time-lapse microscopy to judge which population dominates; developed in a residency at SymbioticA.
works.method_zh: 从成对的参与者身上采血，分离白细胞并染色后共同培养，用延时显微摄影记录它们的相互作用，以判断哪一方占优；在 SymbioticA 驻留期间开发。

works.title: Tree of Knowledge
works.description: Live sculptures of neurons made from neurons: scaffolds and glass tubes are covered with living nerve cells that keep growing, connecting and pruning while on display.
works.description_zh: 用神经元做成的神经元活雕塑：支架和玻璃管上覆盖着活的神经细胞，在展出期间持续生长、建立连接并修剪旧连接。
works.idea_en: Represent a living structure with the living material itself, so the artwork keeps changing like its subject.
works.idea_zh: 用活的材料本身来表现活的结构，让作品像它所表现的对象一样不断变化。
works.method: Neurons are cultured on Matrigel-coated scaffolds and in glass tubes inside an incubator; developed at SymbioticA with Giles Plant's group, Oron Catts and Ionat Zurr, with help from Miguel Vaz Afonso.
works.method_zh: 神经元在涂有 Matrigel 的支架和玻璃管中于培养箱内培养；在 SymbioticA 与 Giles Plant 团队、Oron Catts、Ionat Zurr 合作完成，Miguel Vaz Afonso 提供协助。

works.title: SOMA
works.description: Visitors touch a soft artificial membrane; the touch becomes electrical pulses sent to living brain organoids, and the organoids' response is shown as movement in the same membrane.
works.description_zh: 观众触摸一块柔软的人造薄膜；触摸被转成电脉冲发送给活体脑类器官，类器官的反应又以同一块薄膜的运动表现出来。
works.idea_en: Replace keyboard and screen with touch when the computer is alive, and design for its uncertainty.
works.idea_zh: 当计算机是活的，就用触摸代替键盘和屏幕，并为它的不确定性而设计。
works.method: A tactile membrane with sensors and actuators is linked to neural organoids on FinalSpark's remotely accessible Neuroplatform MEAs, forming a closed stimulation-response loop; made at Zurich University of the Arts (ZHdK).
works.method_zh: 带传感器和执行器的触感薄膜连接到 FinalSpark 可远程访问的 Neuroplatform 多电极阵列上的神经类器官，形成刺激与反应的闭环；在苏黎世艺术大学（ZHdK）完成。

works.title: May the Horse Live in Me
works.description: After months of preparation, Marion Laval-Jeantet is injected with horse blood plasma and then walks with the horse on stilt-hooves in a one-hour performance at Kapelica Gallery, Ljubljana.
works.description_zh: 经过数月准备，Marion Laval-Jeantet 注射了马的血浆，随后穿着高跷般的“马蹄”与马并肩行走，在卢布尔雅那 Kapelica 画廊完成一小时的表演。
works.idea_en: Make kinship with another species a physiological event inside one's own body.
works.idea_zh: 让与另一物种的亲缘关系，成为发生在自己身体内部的生理事件。
works.method: The artist was gradually immunised with different horse immunoglobulins so that a final injection of horse plasma would be tolerated, while an ethologist prepared her and the horse to be together for the performance.
works.method_zh: 艺术家逐步接受不同马免疫球蛋白的免疫处理，使最后注射的马血浆能被耐受；同时由动物行为学家帮助她和马做好共处表演的准备。

works.title: Delicate Balance
works.description: A Siamese fighting fish in a small tank decides which way the tank travels along a stainless-steel tightrope, letting it look beyond the glass and at itself in a mirror.
works.description_zh: 一条暹罗斗鱼决定它所在的小鱼缸沿不锈钢钢索往哪边移动，让它看到缸外的世界，也在镜子里看到自己。
works.idea_en: Give an animal the steering of a vehicle and let its gaze decide where it goes.
works.idea_zh: 把载具的方向盘交给动物，让它的目光决定去哪里。
works.method: The betta crosses infrared break-beams inside the tank, which switch a motor that moves the tank along the wire toward the side it faces; a rear-view mirror at one end lets it see its reflection.
works.method_zh: 斗鱼在缸内穿过红外对射光束，触发电机把鱼缸沿钢索移向它面对的一侧；钢索一端的后视镜让它看见自己的倒影。

works.title: Augmented Fish Reality
works.description: Five rolling robotic fishbowls are steered by the Siamese fighting fish inside them, which drive toward each other, toward visitors or away as they choose.
works.description_zh: 五个会滚动的机器人鱼缸由缸里的暹罗斗鱼驾驶，它们可以自主选择靠近同伴、靠近观众或走开。
works.idea_en: Interactive art for animals: the fish are the users, humans are part of their environment.
works.idea_zh: 给动物的互动艺术：鱼是使用者，人类只是它们环境的一部分。
works.method: Each bowl has four infrared sensors; when a fish swims in front of one, a microcontroller drives the motorised wheels forward, back, left or right, and plants in the bowl absorb fish waste.
works.method_zh: 每个鱼缸装有四个红外传感器，鱼游到某个传感器前，微控制器就驱动轮子前进、后退或左右转；缸内植物吸收鱼的排泄物。

works.title: Enteric Consciousness
works.description: A glass stomach full of living Lactobacillus acidophilus controls a giant robotic tongue chair, which gives visitors a 15-minute massage only while the bacterial culture is alive.
works.description_zh: 一个装满活嗜酸乳杆菌的玻璃「胃」决定一张巨型机器人舌头椅是否工作：只有细菌培养物活着，它才给观众做 15 分钟按摩。
works.idea_en: Make a machine's service depend on the health of a microbial community, like the gut deciding for the body.
works.idea_zh: 让机器的服务取决于微生物群落的健康，就像肠道替身体做决定。
works.method: Bacterial cultures in a hand-blown glass stomach are kept cool by peristaltic pumps; the chair is likely enabled by a sensor reading of the culture's state, and two robotic tongues dip into chocolate and cheese.
works.method_zh: 手吹玻璃胃中的细菌培养物由蠕动泵循环冷却；按摩椅很可能根据对培养物状态的传感读数启动，另有两条机器人舌头蘸取巧克力和奶酪。

works.title: Anicca Antenna: Soil as Brain
works.description: A terrarium of soil, plants, isopods, springtails and microbes acts as the 'brain' of a group of small antenna robots, which move, glow and play insect sounds in response to the living substrate.
works.description_zh: 一个装有土壤、植物、潮虫、跳虫和微生物的生态缸充当一群小型天线机器人的「大脑」，机器人根据这片活土壤做出移动、发光并播放昆虫声音。
works.idea_en: Treat a whole soil ecosystem, not a single animal, as the controller of machines.
works.idea_zh: 把整个土壤生态系统（而非单个动物）当作机器的控制器。
works.method: Cameras and sensors track isopod movement and soil moisture and feed AI-driven robots that respond with motion, light and sound, and in a second version prompt watering of the terrarium.
works.method_zh: 摄像头和传感器跟踪潮虫的运动和土壤湿度，驱动搭载 AI 的机器人以动作、灯光和声音回应；第二版还会提示给生态缸浇水。

works.title: Cockroach Controlled Mobile Robot
works.description: A Madagascar hissing cockroach stands on a trackball on top of a three-wheeled robot; its walking steers the robot, and distance sensors feed back to the insect so it can avoid obstacles.
works.description_zh: 一只马达加斯加发声蟑螂站在三轮机器人顶部的轨迹球上，它的行走驾驶机器人；距离传感器再把障碍信息反馈给这只昆虫。
works.idea_en: Use a living insect as the robot's CPU and close the loop with feedback to its body.
works.idea_zh: 把活昆虫当作机器人的 CPU，并通过对它身体的反馈闭合回路。
works.method: The cockroach's leg movements rotate a ping-pong-ball trackball whose motion is converted into wheel commands; front distance sensors trigger lights that likely nudge the insect away from walls (three versions, 2004–2008).
works.method_zh: 蟑螂的腿转动一个乒乓球轨迹球，其运动被转换为车轮指令；前方距离传感器触发灯光，可能借此引导蟑螂避开墙壁（2004–2008 年共三个版本）。

works.title: growth rendering device
works.description: A machine feeds a plant with light and hydroponic solution and, every 24 hours, prints a rasterised inkjet drawing of it on a scrolling roll of paper.
works.description_zh: 一台机器为植物提供光照和水培营养液，并每 24 小时在滚动的纸卷上用喷墨打印一张植物的栅格图像。
works.idea_en: Let a plant and a machine co-author a drawing whose outcome depends on growth.
works.idea_zh: 让植物和机器共同完成一幅画，结果取决于植物的生长。
works.method: A scanner or camera (likely) captures the plant daily and an inkjet head renders it, then the paper advances about four inches for the next cycle; the system runs indefinitely.
works.method_zh: 扫描或摄像装置（推测）每天记录植物，喷墨头把它画出来，随后纸张前移约四英寸进入下一轮；系统无限期运行。

works.title: fly drawing device
works.description: When a housefly enters a small chamber, sensors track its movements and a drawing arm traces them on paper; when the fly leaves, the paper scrolls and the device waits for the next fly.
works.description_zh: 当一只家蝇进入小舱室，传感器跟踪它的动作，绘图臂把轨迹画到纸上；苍蝇离开后纸张滚动，机器等待下一只苍蝇。
works.idea_en: Let an insect's small movements become the hand of a drawing machine.
works.idea_zh: 让昆虫的细微动作成为绘图机的手。
works.method: Light sensors in the chamber detect the fly and a microcontroller moves a pen arm in real time.
works.method_zh: 舱内的光传感器探测苍蝇，微控制器实时驱动画笔臂。

works.title: fly lights
works.description: Six spherical chambers of houseflies are ringed by spotlights; whenever a fly moves near a sensor, the light pointing in that direction switches on, throwing chaotic beams around the room.
works.description_zh: 六个装有家蝇的球形舱被一圈聚光灯围住；苍蝇靠近某个传感器时，朝那个方向的灯就亮起，把杂乱的光束投满房间。
works.idea_en: Amplify a swarm's invisible micro-movements into architecture-scale light.
works.idea_zh: 把蝇群看不见的细微运动放大为建筑尺度的光。
works.method: Directional sensors inside each chamber are mapped one-to-one to spotlights by a microcontroller.
works.method_zh: 每个舱内的方向传感器通过微控制器与聚光灯一一对应。

works.title: fly blimps
works.description: Three to five helium blimps wander through a space, each steered by up to 50 houseflies living in a chamber underneath.
works.description_zh: 三到五个氦气飞艇在空间中漫游，每个飞艇由下方舱室里多达 50 只家蝇来操控。
works.idea_en: A tiny collective can be the flight brain of a vehicle.
works.idea_zh: 一个微小的集体就能成为飞行器的大脑。
works.method: Sensors detect changing light patterns caused by the flies' movement and an on-board microcontroller drives the propellers accordingly; the chambers hold food and water.
works.method_zh: 传感器检测苍蝇运动造成的光线变化，机载微控制器据此驱动螺旋桨；舱内有食物和水。

works.title: fly tweet
works.description: Houseflies live in an acrylic sphere with a keyboard; when they fly over keys, the characters are typed into Twitter and sent as a tweet at 140 characters or when a fly hits Enter.
works.description_zh: 家蝇生活在一个装有键盘的亚克力球里；它们飞过某个键，对应字符就被输入 Twitter，满 140 字或苍蝇碰到回车键时发出推文。
works.idea_en: Plug a swarm into social media and let it post.
works.idea_zh: 把蝇群接入社交媒体，让它们自己发帖。
works.method: A camera tracks the flies over the keyboard and custom software maps positions to key presses and the Twitter API.
works.method_zh: 摄像头跟踪键盘上方的苍蝇，自编软件把位置映射为按键并调用 Twitter 接口。

works.title: fly revolver
works.description: Houseflies in an acrylic sphere with a target backdrop control a robotic mount that aims a revolver; when a fly lands on the bullseye, the trigger is pulled.
works.description_zh: 亚克力球里的家蝇面对一张靶纸，操控一个瞄准左轮手枪的机械装置；当苍蝇停在靶心时，扳机被扣下。
works.idea_en: Hand a consequential decision to an indifferent organism to make agency and responsibility visible.
works.idea_zh: 把一个后果严重的决定交给毫不在意的生物，让能动性与责任变得可见。
works.method: Video tracking of fly positions on the target is mapped in real time to pan and tilt of the gun mount and to the trigger.
works.method_zh: 视频跟踪苍蝇在靶面上的位置，实时映射为枪架的水平、俯仰转动和扳机动作。

works.title: flyAI
works.description: A colony of houseflies is photographed as they land in front of a camera; if image-recognition software ranks 'fly' first, a pump feeds the colony, otherwise it gets nothing.
works.description_zh: 一群家蝇落在摄像头前时被拍下；如果图像识别软件把「苍蝇」排在第一位，泵就给蝇群送去水和营养，否则什么也没有。
works.idea_en: Make the survival of living beings depend on how well an AI recognises them.
works.idea_zh: 让生物的生存取决于 AI 能否认出它们。
works.method: TensorFlow image classification scores each frame and the confidence for 'fly' sets how much water and nutrient the pump delivers.
works.method_zh: TensorFlow 图像分类为每帧打分，「苍蝇」的置信度决定泵送出多少水和营养。

works.title: fly carving device
works.description: One hundred houseflies in an acrylic sphere control a five-axis CNC router as it carves a block of foam, deciding where, how fast and how deep it cuts.
works.description_zh: 一百只家蝇在亚克力球中操控一台五轴 CNC 雕刻机雕刻泡沫块，决定在哪里切、切多快、切多深。
works.idea_en: Let a swarm drive digital fabrication so the object records their behaviour.
works.idea_zh: 让蝇群驱动数字制造，使成品成为它们行为的记录。
works.method: A camera tracks fly motion; custom software maps a single fly or the collective's activity to G-code for the CNC axes (made at Autodesk Pier 9, likely).
works.method_zh: 摄像头跟踪苍蝇的运动，自编软件把单只苍蝇或群体活动映射为 CNC 各轴的 G 代码（可能在 Autodesk Pier 9 驻留时完成）。

works.title: plant drone
works.description: A live plant rides on a drone and pilots it: signals from its leaves set left-right, forward-back and altitude, while an LED on board draws the flight path in long-exposure night photos.
works.description_zh: 一株活植物搭乘无人机并驾驶它：叶片的信号决定左右、前后和高度，机上的 LED 在夜间长曝光照片中画出飞行轨迹。
works.idea_en: A plant can be a pilot if you read its body as a joystick.
works.idea_zh: 只要把植物的身体读作摇杆，它就能当飞行员。
works.method: An open-source microcontroller reads variable resistance across individual leaves and maps each channel to a flight axis; shown at the Digital Naturalism Conference in Panama (likely 2019).
works.method_zh: 开源微控制器读取各片叶子上的可变电阻，每个通道对应一个飞行轴；曾在巴拿马的 Digital Naturalism Conference 展示（可能为 2019 年）。

works.title: plant machete
works.description: A philodendron controls an industrial robot arm holding a machete, deciding how it swings, jabs and slices through the air.
works.description_zh: 一株喜林芋操控一只握着砍刀的工业机械臂，决定它如何挥砍、刺出和劈划。
works.idea_en: Give a plant a weapon to make its hidden electrical life legible, and unsettling.
works.idea_zh: 给植物一把武器，让它隐藏的电活动变得可读，也令人不安。
works.method: A microcontroller reads varying resistance across the leaves; custom software maps these signals in real time to the robot's joint angles.
works.method_zh: 微控制器读取叶片间变化的电阻，自编软件把信号实时映射为机械臂各关节的角度。

works.title: bamboo bot
works.description: A lucky bamboo plant sits on top of an industrial robot arm and positions the arm itself, while it keeps growing toward a light above.
works.description_zh: 一株富贵竹立在工业机械臂顶端，自己控制机械臂的姿态，同时继续朝上方的光源生长。
works.idea_en: Let a plant move its own body with a borrowed robotic limb.
works.idea_zh: 让植物借用机械肢体移动自己的身体。
works.method: Resistance signals measured through the stalk are mapped in real time to the joints of the robot carrying the plant.
works.method_zh: 通过茎秆测得的电阻信号被实时映射为承载植物的机械臂关节动作。

works.title: Breathing
works.description: A hybrid creature made of a living plant and a robotic body reacts when a visitor breathes close to the plant, turning a very quiet exchange into movement and light.
works.description_zh: 一个由活植物和机械身体组成的混合生物，在观众靠近植物呼吸时做出反应，把一次极其安静的交流转化为动作和光。
works.idea_en: Design interaction at the tempo of a plant: breathing, not clicking.
works.idea_zh: 按植物的节奏设计互动：是呼吸，而不是点击。
works.method: A galvanic-response circuit reads changes in the electrical conductivity of the leaves, which drive the robotic structure; developed during the artist's PhD at the University of Plymouth.
works.method_zh: 皮电（GSR）电路读取叶片电导率的变化来驱动机械结构；作品在艺术家于普利茅斯大学攻读博士期间完成。

works.title: Ecotelemedia (plant–GSR hybrid interface)
works.description: In a telematic performance linking Rio de Janeiro, Copenhagen and Beijing, groups of living plants acted as organic sensors whose signals were sonified together with dancers' gestures.
works.description_zh: 在一场连接里约热内卢、哥本哈根和北京的远程表演中，几组活植物作为有机传感器，其信号与舞者的动作一起被转化为声音。
works.idea_en: Put plants into a networked performance as equal data sources next to human performers.
works.idea_zh: 让植物作为与人类表演者平等的数据源，进入联网表演。
works.method: Two plant-GSR systems, each monitoring three plants, streamed conductivity data over OSC into Pure Data sound engines alongside iPad accelerometers; by the NANO lab (UFRJ) with IT University of Copenhagen.
works.method_zh: 两套植物—GSR 系统（各监测三株植物）通过 OSC 把电导数据与 iPad 加速度计数据一起送入 Pure Data 声音引擎；由 UFRJ 的 NANO 实验室与哥本哈根 IT 大学合作完成。

paper.title: Ecologias híbridas: interações entre organismos artificiais e naturais em ambientes telemáticos

works.title: Ritual for Giant Hissing Madagascar Cockroaches
works.description: Giant hissing cockroaches crawl over the performer's body; each time they cross laser beams, samples of their own hissing are triggered, so the insects shape the piece.
works.description_zh: 巨型发声蟑螂在表演者身上爬行；它们每次穿过激光束，就会触发它们自己嘶嘶声的采样，于是昆虫决定了作品的走向。
works.idea_en: Hand part of a score to animals by letting their movements trigger their own voices.
works.idea_zh: 让动物的动作触发它们自己的声音，从而把一部分乐谱交给它们。
works.method: Laser beams and light sensors detect the cockroaches' movement and interactive software plays back pre-recorded hissing sounds (performed 1995–98).
works.method_zh: 激光束和光传感器检测蟑螂的移动，互动软件播放预先录制的嘶嘶声（1995–98 年间演出）。

works.title: Plants Derail Model Train
works.description: Houseplants wired to electrodes trip a switch on a model railway and derail the train, while spy-camera footage from the train is projected and musicians perform.
works.description_zh: 接上电极的室内植物拨动模型铁路上的道岔，让火车脱轨；同时投影火车上间谍摄像头的画面，乐手现场演奏。
works.idea_en: Replay a Cold War plant-sensing experiment as theatre to question what plants 'know'.
works.idea_zh: 把冷战时期的植物感知实验重演为剧场，追问植物「知道」什么。
works.method: Recreating an experiment by Pierre Sauvin, electrodes read the plants' electrical activity through a computer that actuates a track switch; performed with Damon Holzborn.
works.method_zh: 重现 Pierre Sauvin 的实验：电极读取植物的电活动，经电脑驱动铁轨道岔；与 Damon Holzborn 合作演出。

works.title: The Telegarden
works.description: Anyone on the web could plant, water and watch seedlings in a real garden through an industrial robot arm; over 9,000 members tended it in the first year, and it ran at the Ars Electronica Center until 2004.
works.description_zh: 任何网民都能通过一只工业机械臂在一座真实花园里播种、浇水和观察幼苗；第一年就有 9000 多名成员参与，后来在 Ars Electronica Center 运行到 2004 年。
works.idea_en: A living garden can hold together a remote community that must cooperate to keep it alive.
works.idea_zh: 一座活的花园可以把远程社群凝聚起来，因为大家必须合作才能让它活下去。
works.method: An Adept-1 robot arm with a camera over a circular planter was controlled through a web interface; co-directed with Joseph Santarromana at the University of Southern California.
works.method_zh: 圆形花床上方的 Adept-1 机械臂带摄像头，通过网页界面远程控制；与 Joseph Santarromana 在南加州大学共同主导。

works.title: from here to ear
works.description: A flock of zebra finches lives in a room with electric guitars and amplifiers; when the birds land on the strings or peck them, they produce an ever-changing composition.
works.description_zh: 一群斑胸草雀生活在摆满电吉他和音箱的房间里；它们落在琴弦上或啄琴弦时，就生成一首不断变化的乐曲。
works.idea_en: Set up instruments as habitat and let animal behaviour be the composer.
works.idea_zh: 把乐器布置成栖息地，让动物的行为成为作曲者。
works.method: Amplified electric guitars and cymbals are laid out as perches and nesting sites; the only 'interface' is the birds' everyday behaviour (many versions, including Barbican 2010 and HangarBicocca).
works.method_zh: 接上音箱的电吉他和镲片被布置成栖木和筑巢点，唯一的「界面」是鸟的日常行为（有多个版本，包括 2010 年巴比肯中心和 HangarBicocca）。

works.title: The Hearing Test
works.description: An artistic experiment that tries to detect the high-frequency clicks reported to come from growing plant root tips, and asks what counts as evidence of a plant 'voice'.
works.description_zh: 一项艺术实验，尝试检测据报道由生长中的植物根尖发出的高频咔嗒声，并追问什么才算植物「声音」的证据。
works.idea_en: Use the limits of our listening equipment to question which species' signals we take seriously.
works.idea_zh: 借助听音设备的局限，追问我们会认真对待哪些物种的信号。
works.method: Ultrasonic recording of plant roots in the 20–300 kHz range, where clicks are thought to come from bursting air bubbles; documented in Leonardo Music Journal.
works.method_zh: 在 20–300 kHz 频段对植物根系进行超声录音，这些咔嗒声被认为来自气泡破裂；记录于 Leonardo Music Journal。

paper.title: The Hearing Test: Evidence of a Vegetal Entity

works.title: Forest UnderSound
works.description: Reishi and oyster mycelium and mycorrhizal plant roots grow in a gallery for seven months, their electrical activity generating a live soundscape that changes with the seasons and with visitors nearby.
works.description_zh: 灵芝、平菇菌丝和菌根植物的根在展厅里生长七个月，它们的电活动生成实时声景，随季节和附近的观众变化。
works.idea_en: A slow-growing fungal culture can run a months-long generative composition.
works.idea_zh: 生长缓慢的真菌培养物可以驱动一首持续数月的生成音乐。
works.method: Electrodes on mycelium and roots feed purpose-built circuits that detect micro-fluctuations and translate them into control data for analog and digital synthesizers; first shown at SONICA21, The Museum, Kitchener.
works.method_zh: 菌丝和根上的电极接入自制电路，检测微小波动并转换为模拟、数字合成器的控制数据；首展于基奇纳 The Museum 的 SONICA21。

works.title: Mycelia
works.description: A live performance in VRChat where living mycelium's bio-electrical signals drive the music and a dancer in full-body tracking interprets it inside a crystalline cave world.
works.description_zh: 一场在 VRChat 中的现场表演：活菌丝的生物电信号驱动音乐，全身动捕的舞者在水晶洞穴般的虚拟世界中诠释它。
works.idea_en: Let a fungus perform inside a virtual world through its biodata.
works.idea_zh: 让真菌通过它的生物数据在虚拟世界里演出。
works.method: Bio-sonification hardware on mycelium produces MIDI and control voltage for synthesizers, streamed into a VRChat world built with Sara Lisa Vogl and Meta Crew South Africa; shown at A MAZE. Berlin and Venice VR Expanded 2021.
works.method_zh: 菌丝上的生物声化硬件为合成器输出 MIDI 和控制电压，并流入与 Sara Lisa Vogl 及 Meta Crew South Africa 共同搭建的 VRChat 世界；在 A MAZE. Berlin 和 2021 威尼斯 VR Expanded 展出。

works.title: Symbiont::MyceliOhms
works.description: A seven-month mixed-reality installation where living fungi control point-cloud visuals of an old-growth forest; visitors touch gold sensors on a branch so their bio-electrical signals pass through the fungi into synthesizers.
works.description_zh: 一件为期七个月的混合现实装置：活真菌控制古老森林的点云影像；观众触摸树枝上的金色传感器，他们的生物电信号经由真菌进入合成器。
works.idea_en: Route a human touch through a fungus before it becomes sound, making a duet of two bodies.
works.idea_zh: 让人的触摸先穿过真菌再变成声音，形成两种身体的二重奏。
works.method: Living fungi are wired into a nodal network that drives projected Lidar and photogrammetry scans; touch sensors send visitors' signals through the branch and mycelium to synthesizers; at the Art Gallery of Greater Victoria.
works.method_zh: 活真菌接入节点网络，驱动激光雷达和摄影测量扫描的投影；触摸传感器把观众的信号经树枝和菌丝送入合成器；在大维多利亚美术馆展出。

works.title: Plant Ragas
works.description: Live pieces in which the bio-electrical signals of trees and plants, such as a bigleaf maple, play notes within an Indian classical raga chosen for the time of day.
works.description_zh: 一组现场作品：大叶槭等树木和植物的生物电信号，在按一天中时段选定的印度古典拉格音阶里演奏音符。
works.idea_en: Constrain plant biodata with a musical tradition so it becomes playable music.
works.idea_zh: 用一种音乐传统来约束植物生物数据，让它变成可演奏的音乐。
works.method: Electrodes on leaves feed a biodata-to-MIDI device that drives synthesizers quantised to a raga; recorded outdoors in the Gulf Islands of British Columbia in 2021.
works.method_zh: 叶片上的电极接入生物数据转 MIDI 设备，驱动量化到拉格音阶的合成器；2021 年在不列颠哥伦比亚省海湾群岛户外录制。

works.title: Field Notes
works.description: An album composed over two years in the field with mushrooms and plants wired to synthesizers, their electrical fluctuations playing the melodies.
works.description_zh: 一张历时两年在野外创作的专辑：蘑菇和植物接入合成器，由它们的电信号波动来演奏旋律。
works.idea_en: Treat field recording as live collaboration with fungi rather than capture.
works.idea_zh: 把野外录音当成与真菌的现场合作，而不是采集。
works.method: Biodata sonification devices clipped to mushroom caps and leaves convert conductance changes into MIDI notes played through modular and software synths.
works.method_zh: 夹在菌盖和叶片上的生物数据声化设备把电导变化转成 MIDI 音符，再通过模块和软件合成器播放。

works.title: Plectrum
works.description: An audiovisual performance in which the amplified stridulation signals of leaf-cutter ants play alongside human musicians on guitars and electronics.
works.description_zh: 一场视听表演：被放大的切叶蚁摩擦发声信号，与演奏吉他和电子乐器的人类乐手同台。
works.idea_en: Make an ant colony a band member by amplifying the vibrations it already uses to talk.
works.idea_zh: 放大蚂蚁本来就用来交流的振动，让蚁群成为乐队成员。
works.method: Piezo pickups capture substrate-borne vibrations from the stridulatory organ of Atta cephalotes, which are amplified and processed live with visuals; with Markus Muschenich, João Martins and later Auriel.
works.method_zh: 压电拾音器采集 Atta cephalotes 摩擦发声器官产生的基质振动，现场放大、处理并配合影像；合作者 Markus Muschenich、João Martins，后与 Auriel 合作。

works.title: Thermotaxis
works.description: A redwood ant nest rests in a cooled 'hibernation vessel'; a thermal camera reads the heat produced by the ants and their microbes and turns it into a live composition.
works.description_zh: 一个红林蚁巢置于冷却的「冬眠容器」中；热成像相机读取蚂蚁及其微生物产生的热量，并把它转化为实时乐曲。
works.idea_en: Listen to a colony's metabolism: heat as a musical signal.
works.idea_zh: 聆听一个蚁群的新陈代谢：把热量当作音乐信号。
works.method: A self-regulating cooling system and thermal-camera computer vision map temperature patterns of the Formica rufa nest to acoustic patterns; made with Technarium and Vilnius University.
works.method_zh: 自调节冷却系统加热成像计算机视觉，把 Formica rufa 蚁巢的温度模式映射为声音模式；与 Technarium 和维尔纽斯大学合作。

works.title: The Crossing
works.description: Army ants crossing laser beams in the Amazon rainforest generate data that shapes the sound of three steel sculptures, alongside a night projection of the crossing.
works.description_zh: 亚马孙雨林中的行军蚁穿过激光束，产生的数据塑造三座钢雕塑的声音，同时在夜间投影蚂蚁穿越的画面。
works.idea_en: Use an animal's movement through a sensor field as a live variable in a composition.
works.idea_zh: 把动物穿过传感场的运动当作作曲中的实时变量。
works.method: Low-power lasers and photocells in the Sarayaku forest registered ants interrupting the beams; the data changed pitch and envelope in Sonic Pi on Raspberry Pis driving transducers under corten steel discs.
works.method_zh: 在 Sarayaku 雨林中用低功率激光和光敏电阻记录蚂蚁遮断光束；数据在树莓派上的 Sonic Pi 中改变音高和包络，驱动耐候钢圆盘下的换能器。

works.title: Fish on Wheels
works.description: A pet goldfish drives its tank around a room on a wheeled robot base: when it swims toward a side of the tank, the vehicle moves that way.
works.description_zh: 一条宠物金鱼驾驶放在轮式机器人底座上的鱼缸在房间里移动：它游向鱼缸哪一侧，车就往哪边走。
works.idea_en: Off-the-shelf computer vision is enough to give an animal a vehicle.
works.idea_zh: 现成的计算机视觉就足以给动物一辆车。
works.method: A camera above the tank tracks the fish's position with computer vision software and maps it to motor commands of a small robot car.
works.method_zh: 鱼缸上方的摄像头用计算机视觉软件跟踪鱼的位置，并映射为小型机器人车的电机指令。

works.title: Bee's
works.description: A set of blown-glass diagnostic objects in which a person exhales into a chamber and trained bees fly toward the breath if they smell a disease marker.
works.description_zh: 一组吹制玻璃诊断器皿：人向腔室呼气，受过训练的蜜蜂如果闻到疾病标记物，就会飞向呼气处。
works.idea_en: Borrow another species' senses as a medical interface.
works.idea_zh: 借用另一个物种的感官，作为医疗界面。
works.method: Based on research showing bees can be conditioned (Pavlovian training) to respond to specific odours; the glass objects have an inner chamber for the bees and an outer one for the breath.
works.method_zh: 基于蜜蜂可被条件反射训练、对特定气味做出反应的研究；玻璃器皿内腔放蜜蜂，外腔接收呼气。

works.title: Spore 1.1
works.description: A rubber tree bought at The Home Depot lives in a self-contained ecosystem that waters it only when the company's stock price rises; if it dies, it is returned under the store's one-year guarantee.
works.description_zh: 一株从 The Home Depot 买来的橡皮树生活在一个自给系统里，只有该公司股价上涨时才会被浇水；如果它死了，就按商店一年保证退换。
works.idea_en: Tie a living organism's welfare directly to an abstract economic signal to make the link felt.
works.idea_zh: 把生物的生存直接绑定到一个抽象的经济信号上，让这种关联变得可感。
works.method: An on-board computer with Wi-Fi checks the weekly stock price and controls a watering pump accordingly; won first prize at VIDA 7.0.
works.method_zh: 内置联网电脑每周查询股价，并据此控制浇水泵；获 VIDA 7.0 一等奖。

leads.name: Theresa Schubert — milieu #01-05 (2017-)
leads.why: Performance growing urban and skin microbes on agar; microbial growth only, no sensing or computing.

leads.name: Mind the Fungi (TU Berlin, Vera Meyer)

leads.name: Eduardo Reck Miranda — residency at DTU Biosustain (Pablo I. Nikel lab)

leads.name: Kasia Molga — Human Sensor (2016)
leads.why: Performers' costumes light up with live air-pollution data; environmental sensing without other organisms.

leads.name: Kasia Molga — By the Code of Soil (2018)

leads.name: Saša Spačal — Meta_bolus (2017)

leads.name: Mycelium Network Society
leads.why: Collective around Saša Spačal and others working on fungal networks as interfaces; no project page found on agapea.si.

leads.name: Jenna Sutela — Holobiont / nimiia vibié
leads.why: Named in the brief; not listed on her current site, no media found.

leads.name: Tarsh Bates — The Tangled Field (2016)
leads.why: Kinetic sculpture tracing phenotypic changes of Candida albicans; unclear whether living cultures are used.

leads.name: AKI INOMATA — Think Evolution #1: Kiku-ishi (Ammonite) (2016)
leads.why: Octopus offered a 3D-printed ammonite shell; animal as co-maker.

leads.why: Other plant/tree sound works; Pulsations plays heartbeat sounds through a living tree but does not sense it.

leads.name: Christa Sommerer & Laurent Mignonneau — other living-plant works
leads.why: Brief asked for more plant works besides Interactive Plant Growing; none found quickly.

leads.name: Data Garden / MIDI Sprout
leads.why: Already in gallery (data-garden--plantwave, data-garden--quartet).

leads.name: Interspecifics — Codex Virtualis_Genesis
leads.why: Prix AI & Life Art 2023 HM; AI-generated speculative microorganisms trained on the NARO microbe database; no living organisms act in the work.

leads.name: Interspecifics — Recurrent Morphing Radio
leads.why: AI radio built from streaming-music data; no organisms.

leads.name: Interspecifics — Non-Human Rhythms
leads.why: Live recordings of bacterial fuel cells and Physarum sonified (2016); overlaps Micro-Rhythms / Energy Bending Lab.

leads.name: Gilberto Esparza — Korallysis
leads.why: Current-driven electrolysis devices that accelerate coral growth (2018-2024); corals are cultivated, not sensing.

leads.name: Gilberto Esparza — Parásitos Urbanos
leads.why: Artificial-life robots from e-waste stealing grid power; no living organisms.

leads.name: Thijs Biersteker — Econtinuum
leads.why: AI root sculpture that mimics tree communication using room sensors; no living plant.

leads.name: Thijs Biersteker — Fungal Faculty
leads.why: AI artwork inspired by mycelium networks; no evidence of living fungi being sensed.

leads.name: ::vtol:: — last breath
leads.why: Breath-controlled generative organ (2019); body input but no organism signal beyond breath pressure.

leads.name: ::vtol:: — mycological congress
leads.why: Electronic pseudo-fungi 'Ascoma digitale' imitating fungal warning signals; no living fungi.

leads.name: ::vtol:: — eeg_deer
leads.why: Audiovisual performance with a modified Necomimi EEG interface (2014).

leads.name: Robertina Šebjanič — Echinoidea Future – Adriatic Sensing
leads.why: Sea urchins exposed to low-oxygen stressors as pollution indicators, glass sculptures and Copernicus data (2024).

leads.name: Robertina Šebjanič & Špela Petrič — Humalga
leads.why: Speculative human-algae hybrid evolution project; more material/speculation than sensing.

leads.name: Michael Sedbon — Ants Aided Manufacturing
leads.why: Weaver ants activating materials combined with agent-based CAD (research).

leads.name: Andy Gracie — Drosophila titanus
leads.why: Prix Hybrid Art 2015 HM; artificial selection of fruit flies for Titan conditions; breeding rather than sensing/computing.

leads.name: Andy Gracie — Deep Data Prototypes
leads.why: Tardigrades, Arabidopsis and C. elegans exposed to space-probe data (magnetic fields, spectra, gravity); year unclear.

leads.name: Andy Gracie — Proxy
leads.why: Twin robots searching moss samples for tardigrades and nematodes.

leads.name: Anne Marie Maes — The Sound Beehive Experiment
leads.why: Instrumented hive monitoring colony development via sound (2013-2015); overlaps Transparent Beehive.

leads.name: Agnes Meyer-Brandis — Teacup Tools
leads.why: Prix Hybrid Art 2015 AoD; cybernetic teacups visualising aerosols; no organism interface.

leads.name: Paula Gaetano Adi — Guanaquerx
leads.why: Prix AI & Life Art 2025 Golden Nica; quadruped robot crossing the Andes with muleteers and mules; animals accompany but are not an interface.

leads.name: Bartaku — Hoopgas
leads.why: Experiments using banana ethylene to 'talk' Sansevieria into flowering.

leads.name: BCL (Shiho Fukuhara & Georg Tremmel) — Biopresence
leads.why: Human DNA encoded into tree DNA as living memorials (2002-), using Joe Davis's DNA Manifold silent-codon method; strong DNA-as-data work but no usable image found (bcl.io is JS-only, biopresence.com has a logo only).

leads.name: BCL — Common Flowers / Flower Commons
leads.why: Prix Ars Electronica Hybrid Art 2009 Honorary Mention; DIY cloning and release of Suntory's blue GM carnation. About GMO ownership, no sensing or data aspect.

leads.name: BCL — Ghost in the Cell (2015) and On/Off/Maybe: Towards a Biological Ultimate Machine
leads.why: Hatsune Miku 'DNA' in iPS-derived heart cells (21st Century Museum Kanazawa) and a biological logic machine; no project pages or media reachable.

leads.name: Joe Davis — Audio Microscope
leads.why: Microscope that turns light from living cells into sound so each cell has an acoustic signature; no media found.

leads.name: Joe Davis — Poetica Vaginal (1986)
leads.why: Vaginal contractions converted to a signal and beamed from MIT Millstone radar; body data, not organism computing.

leads.name: Hideo Iwasaki — An der schönen regenbogenfarbenen Donau (2010)
leads.why: Danube bacteria painted as iridescent images visible only from certain angles; bacterial painting rather than sensing/computing.

leads.name: Anna Dumitriu & Alex May — ArchaeaBot, ModCell, BioComputation Robots
leads.why: Robots inspired by archaea, stem cells and optogenetics, but no living organisms inside.

leads.name: Heather Dewey-Hagborg — DNA Spoofing (2013), Watson's Ghost (2021), T3511 (2018)
leads.why: Further DNA-as-data works (genetic countersurveillance, DNA portraits of James Watson, re-identifying a saliva donor); close variants of works already included.

leads.name: Mick Lorusso — Biodiamond Energy Theater (2013)
leads.why: Workshop in which microbial fuel cells power a DIY microscope theatre; image at micklorusso.net.

leads.name: Charlotte Jarvis — Et in Arcadia Ego / In Posse
leads.why: DNA-music storage and synthetic semen works; artist site domain now belongs to someone else, no media found.

leads.name: Hackteria (Marc Dusseiller, Urs Gaudenz)
leads.why: Open-source bioart network; DIY microscopy and bioluminescence workshops rather than discrete artworks; look for specific bacterial sound or sensing pieces.

leads.name: Pinar Yoldas — other works
leads.why: Checked portfolio (Very Loud Chamber Orchestra, Distilling the Sky, Kitty AI); none use living organisms that sense or compute.

leads.name: Orkan Telhan — Breathing Shoe (PUMA x MIT Design Lab, 2018)
leads.why: Shoe material patterned with microbes that eat media and open ventilation holes in response to foot heat; responsive material, fits bio/responsive.

leads.name: Thomas Feuerstein — Prometheus Delivered / OCTOPLASMA (2017)
leads.why: Bacteria dissolve a marble Prometheus and their biomass feeds human liver cells grown into an octopus-liver sculpture; a metabolic chain without sensing or signal.

leads.name: Thomas Feuerstein — PSYCHOPROSA (2015)
leads.why: Algae and fungi feed a chemical pipeline producing a synthetic psychedelic (PSILAMIN); process art, no organism sensing.

leads.name: Stelarc — Ear on Arm
leads.why: Prix Ars Electronica Hybrid Art 2010 Golden Nica; implanted cell-seeded ear scaffold, no living-cell performance.

leads.name: Billy Apple & Craig Hilton — The Immortalisation of Billy Apple (2011)
leads.why: Prix Hybrid Art 2011 HM; the artist's cells immortalised as a cell line; no sensing or signal aspect.

leads.name: Anne Niemetz & Andrew Pelling — The Dark Side of the Cell (2004)
leads.why: Sound installation from AFM recordings of vibrating yeast cell walls (sonocytology; Pelling et al., Science 2004, DOI 10.1126/science.1097640); artist site has an expired certificate, no verified media.

leads.name: Paul Thomas — Midas / Nanoessence
leads.why: AFM-based works sonifying and visualising living and dying skin cells at SymbioticA; no verified page found.

leads.name: Ana Rajčević — Chimera: Cell (2024)
leads.why: Lab-grown organoids as chimeric pendants, with a sensor system by ::vtol::; unclear what the sensors do.

leads.name: Charlotte Jarvis & Patricia Saragüeta — Organ of Radical Care (2023)
leads.why: A collective endometrial cell colony kept alive in a chalice in a nightly performance of care; Ars Electronica 2023.

leads.name: Sandra Lorenzi — How to Read Poetry to Cancer Cells? (2021)
leads.why: Studiotopia residency with VIB Centre for Cancer Biology; unclear whether living cells respond.

leads.name: WhiteFeather Hunter — The Witch in the Lab Coat / Mooncalf
leads.why: Tissue culture with menstrual serum at SymbioticA; site blocks scripts (403).

leads.name: Marianne Lechner et al. — The Silent Scream of Cells (2025)
leads.why: Interactive sculpture about forces on brain cells; no living cells.

leads.name: Justine Emard — Myriades (2025)
leads.why: Magnetic grains in glass move to physiological data from brain axons recorded in a lab; no living cells in the work.

leads.name: BCL (Georg Tremmel, Shiho Fukuhara) — Ghost in the Cell (2015)
leads.why: iPS-derived beating cardiomyocytes for a virtual idol; bcl.io is a stub, still no media (also a grp-c lead).

leads.name: Boryana Rossa
leads.why: Co-author of Snowflake / Neuroplastika; worked in Steve Potter's lab with Ben-Ary.

leads.name: David Bowen — swarm (c. 2008)
leads.why: Autonomous roving device steered by houseflies in a spherical chamber; precursor of fly blimps. Only archived images found.

leads.name: David Bowen — growth modeling device (c. 2009)
leads.why: Laser-scans an onion plant daily and 3D-prints a model of its growth; plant growth drives fabrication but no sensing loop.

leads.why: Telematic performance robot derived from a plant–machine hybrid design; unclear whether a living plant was kept in the final version.

leads.name: Miya Masaoka — Adventures of the Solitary Bee (1999)

leads.why: Later plant-sonification performances continuing Pieces for Plants.

leads.name: Tosca Terán — Mycorrhizal Rhythm Machine (NAISA 2021)
leads.why: Grow room where electrodes in mycorrhizal plant roots trigger synth voices; no usable images on the page.

leads.name: Tosca Terán — Symbiosis/\Dysbiosis (VR)
leads.why: Multiplayer VR in which conductance of Ganoderma lucidum and players' EEG drive the world.

leads.why: Ants 'reanimate' an Andean yupana (abacus) at MAC Quito; unclear whether ant movement drives computation.

leads.why: Hexa legged robot modified to carry a succulent into sun or shade; the plant is a passenger, not a controller, and it is a product demo.

leads.name: Anicka Yi — Life Is Cheap (2017) / Biologizing the Machine (2019)
leads.why: Installations with ant colonies and bacteria, but organisms are not in a sensing or control loop with machines.

leads.name: Martin Howse — Earthcodes / The Dark Interpreter
leads.why: Earth- and soil-based computing works; no living organism clearly in the loop.

leads.name: Akira Nakayasu — Himawari (2009)
leads.why: Robotic sunflower that reacts to people; no living plant (checked).

leads.name: Laura Beloff — The Condition (2016) and R-Bus (Leonardo 2026)
leads.why: Other Beloff works with plants and AI; artist site offline, no media found.

leads.name: Allison Kudla — capacity for (urban eden, human error)

leads.name: Miriam Simun — Interspecies Robot Sex
leads.why: Prix Ars Electronica AI & Life Art 2023 HM; robotic and human pollination after colony collapse; check whether plants/insects act in a machine loop.

leads.name: Tagny Duff — Wastelands
leads.why: Prix Ars Electronica AI & Life Art 2019 HM; bio-art with engineered microbes and speculative fiction about plastic waste.

leads.name: Jiwon Woo — Mother's Hand Taste (Son-mat)
leads.why: Prix Ars Electronica AI & Life Art 2019 HM; hand microbiome and fermentation; microbial but not an interface.

leads.name: Lucie Strecker & Klaus Spiess — Hare's Blood +
leads.why: Prix Ars Electronica Hybrid Art 2015 HM; DNA and Beuys' performance; check whether DNA is used as a data carrier.

leads.name: Mind the Fungi (TU Berlin / Art Laboratory Berlin)
leads.why: Art-science programme on fungi (2018-2020) that produced several fungal-interface artworks; a source for more fungal art.
